title: Markdown to traceable JSONL chunks
title_zh: 把长文切分成保留来源与位置的 JSONL 片段
summary: Split a local Markdown document by character budget, preserving every decoded character and source offsets.
input: One UTF-8 Markdown file, up to 10 MB
output: JSONL records with source, character offsets, stable IDs, and text
